# QR Code Generator

`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from
[qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4),
by Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license (notice included in the file).

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Served locally to generate wallet QR codes in the browser without a CDN or external QR service.
